note: Builds both Darwin closures and runs each built wrapper's --help: a dry run only evaluates, a missing store input surfaces at build time, and the session config is parsed only when alamode starts. On work-mac export WORK_CONFIG=/Users/kondy/work/nix first; the stub hides options the private config sets. Also checks formatting, private Git admission, session policy, real Pi inference and tools, durable coordination, delegation, Forge ownership, and that the session nix client reads through directories it may only search. Native containment tests must also run on the host with nix run .#alamode-check-native. --allow-nix requires an isolated builder; the host daemon socket is never granted.
